items.text: **A throw stops copying its message once per frame** (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/error.rs:825`), per `data/gaps/nvs-runtime/a-throw-copies-its-message-per-frame.json`. `Ctx::push_frame` calls `pending.message().into_owned()` per frame, and `Thrown::message()` builds an owned copy for a thrown object. Read the message only on the path that uses it, then delete the gap record and add a paragraph to `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*. Rule: AGENTS.md priority ordering.
